notes:
This is a link-related example. Links are a browser concept,
terminals have no native link mechanism. A link has a main visible
part (label/text) and a functional part (URL or other type of
functional part) and may have other supportive info. In terminal
output, the functional part must be preserved intact. The main
visible part should be preserved too. Supportive info is usually
omitted.

For images specifically, the image can not be displayed so alt
becomes main visible part, so both image source url and alt if
exist, should be preserved.
